title: University of Arizona Nano Fabrication Center Opens
publisher: Arizona Commerce Authority and University of Arizona
summary: Arizona and the University of Arizona record an expanded semiconductor cleanroom with installed fabrication, metrology, packaging, and teaching capability.
key_findings: The cleanroom expanded from 2,800 to 6,800 square feet.
The facility includes metrology, planarization, photolithography, etching, and packaging capability.
Courses and digital-twin modules are available, but learner and industry outcomes are not reported.
why_it_matters: It is an operating research-and-training asset that can be followed into utilization and workforce outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Advances one named Phase 55Y reader journey.
Separates the current evidence stage from downstream operation or outcome claims.
Creates a specific next-record watch point.
evidence_limits: Opening and equipment lists do not establish utilization or qualified output.
No completion, placement, or employer outcome is reported.
